checks.description: The new branch runs. In Opening and Scout, while the home survey is flown and their base was seen in the last 90s, TrainUnitsMode marks the scout rungs met at what is standing, and tags any production order that changed as a result. Traced through the last fight, it would have fired at 275s (Scout: harv ordered instead of the jeep bought ahead of harvester recovery) and 466s (Opening: msam instead of a jeep). A FAIL in a fight where the survey completed and their base was found means the branch never ran.

The metric this round targets, as GDI. Last fight 6 jeeps ran ScoutMode (94, 116, 128, 151, 255, 276). Five of them were bought after their base was seen at 270s and died at rung 0 with 0 kills. Only scouts bought before the base is found, or after the sighting goes stale, should run ScoutMode now. Reads 0 and passes when we play Nod.
The same claim when we play Nod, whose screen vehicle is bggy. Reads 0 and passes when we play GDI.

Knock-on of the stand-down. Last fight the scout re-buys put the recovery harvester behind two jeeps (ordered 310s, not 275s), the yard held its hq for it, and the first msam was born at 408s. With the harvester first and 2,400 credits not spent on jeeps, the hq and first msam should land sooner. Diagnostic: an early rush moves this. Reads 0 and passes as Nod, or if no msam was built at all.

The Scale gap this round works on. Last fight spent 56.9% of the opponent (losses sit at 26-61, wins at 77-149). The opponent's expansions dominate this number, so it is an observation, not a claim the change can carry alone.

What the stand-down could cost. The re-bought scouts re-drove the corridor to their base. Last fight explored 393 cells against the fitness reference of 300. The survey and the first scout's run to their base still happen, so this should stay at or above 300 unless the win comes very quickly.
The stand-down needs the home survey to be complete, so it can never stop the survey that lets the resource layer see home ground. Last fight completed it at 265s.
Credits taken off scouts go to the harvester rung first. The fleet must not shrink: last fight peaked at 8 harvesters.
No fight may run past the benchmark's 2,400s limit. A timed-out benchmark game voids its pair, and three voided pairs stop training.
